name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Heat the olive oil in a heavy saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 10 minutes, until soft and sweet but not coloured.

Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, then raise the heat and add the beef mince. Break it up with a wooden spoon and brown it properly — 8 minutes, until the liquid has gone and the meat is catching on the base.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes so it darkens, then add the passata, stock and oregano.
Bring to a simmer, drop the heat to low and cook uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick and glossy. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Toss the drained pasta through the sauce with a splash of the cooking water so it clings, and serve with the grated parmesan.
